about.name: CHARLEE
about.bio:
As an Information Systems Student and Software Engineer, I specialize in translating complex business needs into efficient web applications.

From digitizing operational workflows to architecting frontend interfaces, I thrive on building scalable full-stack solutions from the ground up that deliver real-world impact.

description: Built a web-based payroll system integrated with KPI evaluation for 2 branches (Ciranjang & Sukaluyu).
Designed Owner, Manager, and Branch Head role structures with distinct permissions using Laravel Gate.
Developed a KPI system with 3 measurable indicators: Attendance (auto-calculated), Discipline, and Sales Contribution.
Built a payroll reporting module with PDF export using DomPDF.
Built a village profile website using Laravel 11 to support a community service (KKN) program.
Developed public and admin modules for village profiles, event agendas, galleries, and news articles.
Designed scalable database migrations and models for village data structures.
Built a Point-of-Sale (POS) and inventory management system using Laravel 11.
Implemented real-time data updates with AJAX for cashier transactions.
Designed a multi-role authentication system to separate cashier and admin access.
Developed 'Nexus Breach', a top-down cyberpunk shooter built with HTML5 Canvas, featuring A* pathfinding and a Finite State Machine (FSM) enemy AI system.
Developed 'Forest Shadows', a stealth-puzzle game with a fox protagonist, using vision-cone based guard AI and A* waypoint patrol.
Composed procedural game music using the Web Audio API for both titles.
